notes:
• New: the Quiz has two modes. Recognize: tap the answer. Perform: sign the answer on camera, Levels 1-10.
• Perform Level N opens after Recognize Level N. Each question gives you 3 tries.
• Quiz XP is now 30 per correct answer in both modes (150 a level). Play Perform to earn the rest back.
• Leaving a level now asks first, so you don't quit by accident.
